{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit crew-neck sweater, fitted, hip-length, deep burgundy #6B1E2E, merino wool

Straight-leg trousers, high-waisted, ankle-length, black #1C1C1E, wool-blend crepe with a little stretch

Tailored short blazer, single-breasted, hip-length, charcoal #3A3B3F, textured wool tweed

Ankle boots, round toe, low 3 cm block heel, black #141414, smooth leather

Small crossbody bag, compact, zip closure, black #1A1A1A, matte leather

Stud earrings, small and round, silver #C0C0C0, polished metal

This outfit keeps the classic, restrained look you asked for while staying neat enough for an evening out. The deep burgundy suits your dark hair, brown eyes and warm skin, and it still looks rich under club lighting. The blazer adds an autumn layer you can take off in the heat of the crowd, and the ankle-length trousers with a low block heel are comfortable for standing for hours. The zip crossbody bag keeps your hands free and your things safe, and the dark palette copes well with a crowded, lively venue."}
